visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a split-screen. The top half shows a close-up of a blonde woman's face as she demonstrates a facial massage, using her fingers to press and pull the skin near her cheekbones. The bottom half shows a young woman with long brown hair in a cream sweater, looking directly at the camera and speaking with expressive facial movements in a brightly lit indoor setting. (2) A jump cut occurs on the bottom screen where a distortion filter is applied to the woman's face, creating an unnaturally large mouth and chin; she appears shocked, with eyes widened and eyebrows raised. The top screen continues showing the facial massage. (3) The scene transitions to the woman in a new setting, wearing a white bathrobe and a white bunny-ear headband. She is in a walk-in closet with shelves of designer handbags visible in the background. She applies a white cream from a tube to her face, massaging it into her cheeks with circular hand motions. (4) Close-up shots show the woman performing the massage steps: she pushes her nose to one side with her hand, pulls the skin from her nose towards her temples, uses her thumbs to press under her cheekbones, and finally uses the side of her hand (tiger's mouth) to lift her jawline upwards. Her eyes are focused on her reflection or the camera throughout. (5) The final segment shows a split-screen comparison and then a full face shot of her. One side of her mouth is visually higher than the other after the massage. She smiles at the camera, pointing at her jawline to highlight the slimming effect against the backdrop of the luxury closet.
